recentItems.title: Band of the Welsh Guards, Changing the Guard 2026
recentItems.description: The Band play 'The Thin Red Line' by Kenneth J Alford as they lead the Old Guard found by the 1st Bn Grenadier Guards back to Wellington Barracks.  27 July 2026.

recentItems.title: Band of the Welsh Guards, Changing the Guard 2026
recentItems.description: The Band play 'New Colonial' by Robert Browne Hall as they lead the New Guard found by the 1st Bn Grenadier Guards from Wellington Barracks.  27 July 2026.

recentItems.title: Corps of Drums 1st Bn Grenadier Guards, Changing the Guard 2026
recentItems.description: The Corps of Drums play 'Wellington' by Wilhelm Zehle and 'Galanthia' by William H Turpin as they lead the Old Guard found by the 1st Bn Grenadier Guards along the Mall passing the King's Life Guard found by the Life Guards.  27 July 2026.

recentItems.title: Massed Bands of HM Royal Marines, Beating Retreat 2006
recentItems.description:
The Massed Bands return along the Mall to Wellington Barracks.  
Music played: Marches: Heart of Oak; A Life on the Ocean Wave; Happy Days; High School Cadets; Blaze Away and Army of the Nile.  Drum Links: Illawalla; San Carlos and Wyndham. 17 July 2026.
